current_ratio_weak.description: Current ratio below this = current liabilities exceed current assets (weak).

current_ratio_safe.description: Current ratio at or above this is considered safe/strong.

current_ratio_excess.description: Current ratio above this (with high cash ratio) suggests idle, unproductive cash.

quick_ratio_critical.description: Quick ratio below this = severe shortage of quick (non-stock) liquid assets.

quick_ratio_safe.description: Quick ratio below this while current ratio is strong = liquidity tied up in stock.

cash_ratio_low.description: Cash ratio below this = very little cash cover for short-term liabilities.

cash_ratio_idle.description: Cash ratio above this (with very high current ratio) = surplus cash sitting idle.

crisis_runway_days.description: Runway below this many days = cash runs out within a month (critical).

short_runway_days.description: Runway below this many days = short runway.

safe_runway_days.description: Runway at or above this many days (about 3 months) is comfortable.

slow_collection_days.description: Average collection period above this = slow collections.

very_slow_collection_days.description: Average collection period above this = very slow collections.

good_collection_days.description: Collection period at or below this = disciplined collections.

max_receivables_to_sales.description: Receivables above this many months of sales is too high.

healthy_receivables_to_sales.description: Receivables at or below one month of sales is healthy; above it, concentration risk grows.

max_credit_gap_days.description: If customers take this many more days than suppliers give you, you are financing customers.

slow_stock_days.description: Stock taking longer than this to sell = slow-moving.

dead_stock_days.description: Stock taking longer than this to sell = dead / obsolete risk.

lean_stock_days.description: Stock days at or below this = lean inventory.

max_inventory_to_sales.description: Inventory above this many months of sales = overstocking.

lean_inventory_to_sales.description: Inventory at or below this many months of sales = lean.

perishable_stock_days.description: Restaurants holding stock longer than this many days risk spoilage.

long_ccc_days.description: Cash conversion cycle above this many days is long.

manufacturing_long_ccc_days.description: For manufacturers, CCC above this many days = long production-to-cash cycle.

fast_payment_days.description: Paying suppliers in fewer days than this = paying too quickly.

stretched_payment_days.description: Taking more than this many days to pay suppliers = dangerously stretched.

dsr_moderate.description: Loan installment above this share of gross profit = high debt servicing.

dsr_heavy.description: Loan installment above this share of gross profit = unsustainable.

thin_margin_pct.description: Wholesale/trading gross margin below this % is thin.

cash_business_credit_days.description: Retail/restaurant collection days above this = unnecessary credit in a cash business.

services_billing_days.description: Service firms collecting slower than this many days = slow billing.

watch_score.description: Health score below this (and >= crisis score) = Risky.

healthy_score.description: Health score at or above this can be Healthy (if no Critical/High problems).

weight_critical.description: Health-score penalty for a Critical problem (multiplied by its CF).

weight_high.description: Health-score penalty for a High problem (multiplied by its CF).

weight_medium.description: Health-score penalty for a Medium problem (multiplied by its CF).

weight_low.description: Health-score penalty for a Low problem (multiplied by its CF).

strength_bonus.description: Health-score bonus for each strength found.

cap_min_cf.description: A Critical problem caps the status at Risky only if its combined CF is at least this (Likely or stronger). Weaker (Possible) Critical/High problems still block Healthy.

not_sure_cf.description: CF of a 'Not sure' answer (0-1). Rules testing 'symptom = Yes' also fire on Not sure, with conclusion CF = rule CF x this value.
